q1_issues.issue: The non-finite "to burn ..." complement is sealed under Theme, but the instruction set restricts sealing to finite clausal complements ("a control verb with a to-infinitive never seals"), and the requested object "permission" is dropped entirely — no permission witness and no oblique for "asked ... for permission" — with its content re-expressed as a (Permitted sk_burn_1) status inside the seal.

(Cardinality sk_group_4 (ParticleFromNormal 12 1.2)) puts a distribution in Cardinality's value slot, which is specified as a native integer; ParticleFromNormal is licensed only in Measure-family magnitude slots and approximate clock-time values.

(Inheritance normal_night night) — with (Inheritance normal_night normal) at 79 — puts in a class position the symbol statement 77 uses as an individual time filler, and "a normal night" is incidental description, which the adjective+noun fuse test excludes from compounding in the first place.

(Agent sk_repel_1 wintergloss) fills a role slot for the specific definite "The wintergloss" with the bare class symbol, which the instruction set reserves for non-specific/generic fillers and bars for a specific definite individual.

q2_gaps: "ask X for permission to V" — a request frame whose prepositional object is the noun "permission" taking an infinitival complement; nothing settles whether the requested act rides the noun's For-complement as a tenseless top-level event, a seal, or a deontic status atom

an approximated count ("about twelve nightmoths") — exact Cardinality requires a native integer and CardinalityPhrase is for vague words carrying no number, so a hedged numeral count has no licensed form
a typicality frame adverbial ("on a normal night") characterizing a habitual occasion — it is neither a calendar Time slot, an Every/TimesPer period or rate, nor a ConditionalProperty condition

a definite anaphor whose antecedent was licensed as a bare kind filler ("burn wintergloss" ... "The wintergloss repelled ...") — reusing the kind symbol puts a class in an individual role slot, while minting a fresh witness breaks the coreference
notes: The negated group sentence is handled exactly per doctrine (strength-0 group bundle plus the strength-0 per-member rule, time atoms inside), as are the Sunken Cove / Stilllight Lantern name-plus-kind atoms, the bare-plural episodic group witnesses, and the Theme/Patient splits on approve, produce, count and record. Alongside is a legitimate preposition-named oblique, so no head is unlicensed.
